content: In adults with type 2 diabetes who have advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD) with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of less than 30 ml/min, the therapeutic benefits of SGLT2 inhibitors are typically diminished. In such cases, GLP-1 receptor agonists are the preferred treatment option as they are more effective in reducing the risk of hypoglycemia and cardiovascular complications.
